description.message: Copy a web page, or a part of it, and paste it into nib as editable layers.

copied.message: Copied $1 layers. Paste them in nib.

copiedSome.message: Copied the first $1 layers (the page has more). Paste them in nib.

cannotRead.message: Chrome does not let extensions read this page.

clipboardDenied.message: This page did not allow copying. Use Copy this page instead.

pickHint.message: Click an element to copy it for nib. ↑ picks its parent, Esc cancels.
